#!/bin/bash
# Raw-byte differential test.
#
# spawnSync cannot carry invalid UTF-8 (a JS string round-trips through U+FFFD),
# so these cases go through the shell, which passes bytes to execve untouched.
# Python decodes such bytes with surrogateescape; the port must match.

set -u
ref=/workspace/dataset/test2_executable
port=/output/test2.mjs
pass=0
fail=0

check() {
  local label="$1"; shift
  local r p rrc prc
  r=$("$ref" "$@" 2>&1 | sed 's/\[PYI-[0-9]*:ERROR\]/[PYI-PID:ERROR]/'); rrc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
  p=$(node "$port" "$@" 2>&1 | sed 's/\[PYI-[0-9]*:ERROR\]/[PYI-PID:ERROR]/'); prc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
  if [ "$r" = "$p" ] && [ "$rrc" = "$prc" ]; then
    pass=$((pass + 1))
  else
    fail=$((fail + 1))
    echo "FAIL $label"
    echo "  ref  (rc=$rrc): $(printf '%s' "$r" | od -c | head -4)"
    echo "  port (rc=$prc): $(printf '%s' "$p" | od -c | head -4)"
  fi
}

# Single invalid bytes across the whole 0x80-0xff range.
for b in $(seq 128 255); do
  arg=$(printf "\\x$(printf '%x' "$b")")
  check "byte-0x$(printf '%02x' "$b")" --key "$arg" --val 1
done

# Multi-byte mixes: truncated sequences, overlongs, surrogates, out-of-range,
# and invalid bytes adjacent to valid text.
for hex in 8081 c0af c1bf c3 c3a9 e282 e282ac eda080 edbfbf f09f9880 f4908080 f5808080 \
           fefe ffff 61ff 61ffa 2fff2f 09ff0a 27ff27 22ff22 5cff5c 616263ff; do
  arg=$(printf "$(printf '%s' "$hex" | sed 's/../\\x&/g')")
  check "hex-$hex" --key "$arg" --val 1
done

# Invalid bytes in the option name and in --val (which is parsed but unused).
check "badopt" $'--\xff' a --val 1
check "badval" --key a --val $'\xff'
check "badeq"  $'--key=\xff' --val 1

echo
echo "$pass passed, $fail failed"
[ "$fail" -eq 0 ]
